title: Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin'
description:
Plan out your turns to skilfully weave between bullets!

As you progress deeper, your enemies will have deadlier and more dastardly bullet patterns, so don’t get overwhelmed!

Every single weapon does something unique – Bat bullets back with a Baseball Bat, freeze enemies with an Ice Blast or even jump over bullets with a Feather!

You never know what you’re gonna get when you smash open a weapon crate!

Upgrades change the way you play – Hover over bottomless pits, turn your weapons into automatic turrets or even remote control your bullets!

You can only hold so many upgrades – choose wisely!

With snappy gameplay and no waiting for enemy turns, you can blast through the game at whatever pace you like – but don’t forget to slow down if you need to!

Keep killing enemies to keep up your combo and get more coins! Each turn wasted will tick down the timer, so keep the pressure on your foes!
description_short: Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin' is a unique fusion of traditional turn-based roguelikes and twin-stick shooters. A fast-paced take on strategy games where you dodge deadly bullet patterns and kill enemies for their money - all at your own pace.
